invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null Option<HoodieRollbackPlan> (possibly empty), as it is constructed by the execute() method.
instantTime is passed directly to another method as a parameter; it is likely non-null for proper functioning of the plan execution.
instantToRollback must be non-null for the rollback process and is passed into plan executor.
If the Option is present, then get() will return a non-null HoodieRollbackPlan (by Option semantics).
As a boolean parameter, skipTimelinePublish can only be true or false (included for completeness).
